name: pboc_get_policy_rate
description:
A Chinese interest rate in percent, monthly, from FRED: discount_rate is the PBoC discount rate (INTDSRCNM193N, IMF series; it changes rarely and FRED updates it with a lag), interbank_3m the 3-month interbank rate (IR3TIB01CNM156N, OECD series). FRED has no Loan Prime Rate, lending or deposit rate or government bond yield for China, so none is offered.
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): rate_type (discount_rate, interbank_3m; default discount_rate); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
All series: pboc_list_series. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so.
Example: {"rate_type": "interbank_3m", "recent_periods": 12}

rate_type.description: discount_rate: PBoC discount rate; interbank_3m: 3-month interbank rate

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
